### Why the Header & Footer Were Missing
The group's shared [assets/js/layout.js](file:///C:/Users/X1/Semester%201%20Projects/IICT%20project/E_Group_7_HighlandHorizons/assets/js/layout.js#L188-L228) loads [components/header.html](file:///C:/Users/X1/Semester%201%20Projects/IICT%20project/E_Group_7_HighlandHorizons/components/header.html) and [components/footer.html](file:///C:/Users/X1/Semester%201%20Projects/IICT%20project/E_Group_7_HighlandHorizons/components/footer.html) using `fetch()`. When you open `pages/destinations.html` directly by double-clicking the file (`file://`), browsers block `fetch()`, leaving `#site-header` and `#site-footer` empty.

### File Changed
- **[pages/destinations.html](file:///C:/Users/X1/Semester%201%20Projects/IICT%20project/E_Group_7_HighlandHorizons/pages/destinations.html#L19-L368)** — Placed the exact markup from [components/header.html](file:///C:/Users/X1/Semester%201%20Projects/IICT%20project/E_Group_7_HighlandHorizons/components/header.html) and [components/footer.html](file:///C:/Users/X1/Semester%201%20Projects/IICT%20project/E_Group_7_HighlandHorizons/components/footer.html) inside `<div id="site-header">` and `<div id="site-footer">` (with `../assets/images/logo.svg` for the logo path and `href="destinations.html"` for the Destinations link):
  - **When opened directly (`file://`):** The shared header and footer appear immediately with full styling from [layout.css](file:///C:/Users/X1/Semester%201%20Projects/IICT%20project/E_Group_7_HighlandHorizons/assets/css/layout.css) and Bootstrap collapse/dropdown support.
  - **When opened on a local server (`http://`, e.g., VS Code Live Server):** [layout.js](file:///C:/Users/X1/Semester%201%20Projects/IICT%20project/E_Group_7_HighlandHorizons/assets/js/layout.js) still dynamically loads the latest shared components from `components/` as designed.
- No shared files, teammate files, hero styles, destination cards, photos, search, or filters were modified.

*(Note: Currently only [pages/destinations.html](file:///C:/Users/X1/Semester%201%20Projects/IICT%20project/E_Group_7_HighlandHorizons/pages/destinations.html) and [header-footer-preview.html](file:///C:/Users/X1/Semester%201%20Projects/IICT%20project/E_Group_7_HighlandHorizons/header-footer-preview.html) exist in the repository—the other 14 group pages haven't been added yet, so their nav/footer links keep `href="#"` as in [components/header.html](file:///C:/Users/X1/Semester%201%20Projects/IICT%20project/E_Group_7_HighlandHorizons/components/header.html) and [components/footer.html](file:///C:/Users/X1/Semester%201%20Projects/IICT%20project/E_Group_7_HighlandHorizons/components/footer.html).)*

### Verification Results
Tested in headless Chrome under both protocols after the final edit:
- **`file://` check:** Shared header, shared footer, `../assets/images/logo.svg`, and all 4 destination cards rendered properly.
- **`http://` check:** Header, footer, header/footer logos, active `Destinations` nav link, all 4 destination photos, region filters, and combined search + filtering all passed.
